designDecisions: Dark theme with #000 page bg and #1c1c1e card surfaces per Library .dark semantic tokens
Nav follows Library navigation preview: sticky 44-52px dark bar with backdrop blur, pill-shaped links, brand logo left, CTA right
Search input follows Library input preview: pill-shaped (980px radius), 52px height, leading icon, transparent bg with subtle border
Genre/instrument chips: pill-shaped clickable spans with subtle border, 980px radius per Library button pill convention, whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0 for horizontal scroll
Sample pack cards follow Library card preview pattern: border + background (no shadow), hover border-color transition, 16px radius (within Library radius-max 19.2px)
Card gradient artwork uses 2-stop same-hue gradients per aesthetics rules (no rainbow/3+ stop), using Apple HIG system colors
Trust signals follow Library UI Kit feature-stripe pattern: 3-column grid, icon + title + description, internal dividers using border token
Footer follows Library UI Kit footer pattern: 4-column grid, 12px type, muted foreground, bottom bar with copyright and links
Pill CTA '立即体验' follows Library button primary variant: brand-400 fill (dark mode primary), 980px radius, 32px height
Active nav state uses font-weight 600 + foreground color (single emphasis method per Gate 9)
Responsive grid: 4-col desktop -> 2-col tablet (832px) -> 1-col mobile (480px) via media queries
qualityRisks: fill-html-head.mjs failed due to missing radius-sm/md/lg semantic mappings in Library CSS; head infrastructure was manually injected as FullHtmlReplaceHead fallback. Main Agent should run fill-html-head.mjs --replace-head to standardize if script is patched.

designIntentEvidence.visualNorthStarApplied: Splice-inspired dark audio browsing platform with Apple Design Library calm restraint; information focus is instant via centered hero heading and prominent search bar
designIntentEvidence.compositionPatternUsed: Large/medium/small stacked: oversized search hero (first screen), medium-density chip browsing (second), dense 4-column card grid (third), compact trust/footer
designIntentEvidence.antiSlopCheck: No rainbow gradients, no icon tile wall, no generic hero; gradients are 2-stop same-hue per aesthetics rules; cards use border not shadow; chips use subtle outline not filled blocks

interactionStates.buttons: default/hover (filter brightness 0.96)/active/focus-visible (ring)/disabled coverage on CTA; play buttons have hover background transition
interactionStates.navigation: nav links have color opacity transition on hover; active state uses font-weight 600 + foreground color (single method)
interactionStates.cardsAndMedia: pack cards have border-color transition + transform on hover; cursor pointer indicates clickability
interactionStates.forms: search input has border-color transition on focus; placeholder uses muted-foreground token

alignmentModeByRegion: pack-grid: left-edge grid with uniform gap
footer: left-edge columns, space-between bottom bar

headingCtaEvidence.headingPolicy: all headings are short noun phrases: '探索声音' (4 CJK), '浏览乐器' (4 CJK), '最新采样包' (5 CJK); no sentence headings
headingCtaEvidence.ctaPolicy: CTA labels are concise: '立即体验' (4 CJK), '探索全部' (4 CJK); long copy moved to subtitle/body
longCopySplitExamples: subtitle '搜索百万级正版采样音色' moved below heading as body text

motionEvidence: Pill CTA hover filter:brightness(0.96) provides subtle feedback; nav links have opacity transition; cards have border-color + transform hover; search input has border-color focus transition; all using CSS-only transitions (180ms ease) -- no JS animation libraries needed

headCommandEvidence.headCommandUsed: node fill-html-head.mjs <css> <html> --replace-head (failed due to Library radius mapping; manual head injection performed)

sharedFragmentsPreserved: Standalone page generation; no shared fragments to preserve
